summary.summary:
Migrated pydantic_cli from pydantic 1 to the pydantic 2 API.

- pydantic_cli/__init__.py: removed pydantic.fields.ModelField / SHAPE_* usage. Field handling now takes a FieldInfo; a new helper __unwrap_field_annotation derives the v1 type_/allow_none/shape from the annotation (Optional, List, Set, X | None). required uses field.is_required(), default maps PydanticUndefined to None, description/extra use field.description and field.json_schema_extra. cls.__fields__ -> model_fields, cls.schema() -> model_json_schema(), cls.validate() -> model_validate(), cli_config.copy() -> model_copy().
- Optional[T] without a default is no longer required on the CLI (pydantic 1 behavior; pydantic 2 would make it required). Trade-off: an explicit Optional[T] = Field(...) also becomes optional on the CLI, since pydantic 2 exposes no way to distinguish it from a bare Optional[T].
- pydantic_cli/core.py: CliConfig uses model_config = ConfigDict(validate_default=True, validate_assignment=True) instead of class Config. _get_cli_config_from_model reads the user's nested Config via getattr with a fallback, so models without a Config still work.
- Examples: Field(cli=...) (no longer supported) -> Field(json_schema_extra={"cli": ...}) in 6 example files. simple_with_enum_by_name.py: __get_validators__ -> __get_pydantic_core_schema__ with a before-validator that keeps the case-insensitive lookup.
- REQUIREMENTS.txt: pydantic >= 2.0, < 3 (setup.py reads it). No other companion packages are pinned in this repo.
- Not updated: README.md still shows cli= in Field examples (docs only). Those should be switched to json_schema_extra.

Full test suite: 36 passed on pydantic 2.14.3.

arguments.summary:
Migrated pydantic_cli from pydantic 1 to the pydantic 2 API.

- pydantic_cli/__init__.py: removed pydantic.fields.ModelField / SHAPE_* usage. Field handling now takes a FieldInfo; a new helper __unwrap_field_annotation derives the v1 type_/allow_none/shape from the annotation (Optional, List, Set, X | None). required uses field.is_required(), default maps PydanticUndefined to None, description/extra use field.description and field.json_schema_extra. cls.__fields__ -> model_fields, cls.schema() -> model_json_schema(), cls.validate() -> model_validate(), cli_config.copy() -> model_copy().
- Optional[T] without a default is no longer required on the CLI (pydantic 1 behavior; pydantic 2 would make it required). Trade-off: an explicit Optional[T] = Field(...) also becomes optional on the CLI, since pydantic 2 exposes no way to distinguish it from a bare Optional[T].
- pydantic_cli/core.py: CliConfig uses model_config = ConfigDict(validate_default=True, validate_assignment=True) instead of class Config. _get_cli_config_from_model reads the user's nested Config via getattr with a fallback, so models without a Config still work.
- Examples: Field(cli=...) (no longer supported) -> Field(json_schema_extra={"cli": ...}) in 6 example files. simple_with_enum_by_name.py: __get_validators__ -> __get_pydantic_core_schema__ with a before-validator that keeps the case-insensitive lookup.
- REQUIREMENTS.txt: pydantic >= 2.0, < 3 (setup.py reads it). No other companion packages are pinned in this repo.
- Not updated: README.md still shows cli= in Field examples (docs only). Those should be switched to json_schema_extra.

Full test suite: 36 passed on pydantic 2.14.3.
